commit.message:
Add Ruff linting to pre-commit and fix tools/python lint

- Add Ruff pre-commit hooks (ruff and ruff-format) scoped to tools/python
- Enable ANN (type annotation) rules in pyproject.toml Ruff config
- Fix lint issues in tools/python/profile_extensions.py and tools/python/udb.py
- Add proper type hints and use pathlib idioms
- Add SPDX license headers to pyproject.toml

commit.message:
Merge main into add-ruff-linting and bump container tag

- Resolved merge conflict in requirements.txt (kept both ruff and spython)
- Bumped bin/.container-tag from 0.15 to 0.16 as requested by maintainer

style: apply ruff formatting and lint fixes to server.py

- Fix import sorting (I001)
- Replace deprecated typing imports (Dict, List, Set, Optional) with modern syntax
- Use contextlib.suppress instead of try-except-pass
- Rename unused loop variables to underscore prefix
- Apply ruff formatting

fix: Rename 'Option Extensions' to 'Optional Extensions' in CRD

Fixes #1389

Changed to_s to to_s_concise in proc_crd.adoc.erb template to correctly
display 'Optional Extensions' instead of 'Option Extensions' in the
generated CRD document.
